fusions.name: Eventual Jab
fusions.desc: A slow, certain thrust that deals 15 damage, leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds, stuns it for 1.4 seconds and leaves it [Hindered] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Unhurried Verdict
fusions.desc: Settles the haft and thrusts, dealing 40 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Lie Still
fusions.desc: Restores 2 health a second to you for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Rested at Last
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you restore 15 stamina. Once every 60 seconds.
